facts.fact: POTRAZ, as the data protection authority, takes part in the Network of African Data Protection Authorities (NADPA-RAPDP), Africa CIRT and SADC CIRT.
facts.system: Network of African Data Protection Authorities

facts.fact: POTRAZ has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Information Regulator of South Africa on cross-border regulatory cooperation in data protection; the signing date is not given.
facts.system: POTRAZ-Information Regulator of South Africa MoU
